title.zh: 富兰克林推出两只美股比特币分红再投资ETF
title.en: 富兰克林推出两只美股比特币分红再投资ETF

current_state.zh: Franklin Templeton launched two US-listed ETFs, FBEQ and FIBT, that hold about 95% US equities and 5% Bitcoin exposure while reinvesting dividends into Bitcoin through ETPs, futures, and options.
current_state.en: Franklin Templeton launched two US-listed ETFs, FBEQ and FIBT, that hold about 95% US equities and 5% Bitcoin exposure while reinvesting dividends into Bitcoin through ETPs, futures, and options.
